audience: finance teams that pay vendor bills and send invoices through Mercoa

useCases.title: Find bills that wait for approval
useCases.text: The AI searches invoices by status, entity, date and approver and opens each one. You get the bills that need an approver, with amount and vendor.

useCases.title: See the history of an invoice
useCases.text: The AI reads the audit log of an invoice: status changes, approvals and payments, so you can tell who did what and when.

useCases.title: Total invoice amounts per entity and currency
useCases.text: The AI reads invoice totals and counts for an entity's payables or receivables, grouped by currency, for AP and AR overviews and aging.

useCases.title: Check payment transactions for an invoice or entity
useCases.text: The AI searches payment transactions by entity, invoice, status, type and date and opens one to read it.

useCases.title: Find or add a vendor or customer
useCases.text: The AI searches entities by name, email or foreign id. If none exists, it creates a new entity with its role flags and a business or individual profile.

useCases.title: Create a bill, update it or add a comment
useCases.text: The AI creates an invoice as a draft or submitted bill, moves its status forward, changes amounts, dates or payment methods, or adds a comment to its log.
